info.name: Laravel E-Commerce API
info.description:
Collection covering the full E-Commerce API.

## Authentication

All protected requests require a `Bearer` token issued by `POST /api/login` or `POST /api/register`.

The collection uses a `{{token}}` variable for authorization.

- `POST /api/register` and `POST /api/login` automatically save the returned token into the `{{token}}` collection variable (and into `{{customer_token}}`, `{{salesman_token}}` or `{{admin_token}}` on register based on the chosen role).
- To test role-based permissions, register users with the roles `customer`, `salesman` and `admin`, then use the corresponding role token in the `Authorization` tab of protected requests (or set `{{token}}` to one of the role tokens).

## Roles

| Role | Can do |
| ---- | ------ |
| customer | List/view products, manage own cart, place/list/view own orders |
| salesman | All customer actions + create/update/delete **own** products, change order status |
| admin | Everything (all products, all orders, change order status, confirm emails) |

## Notes on response wrapping

- `register`, `login`, `logout`, cart messages and order objects are returned **without** a `data` wrapper.
- `ProductResource` (`GET /api/products`, `GET/POST/PUT /api/products/{id}`) and cart **index** wrap the payload in a `data` key because they use Laravel API Resources.

## Error status codes

- `401 Unauthenticated` – missing/invalid bearer token.
- `403 Forbidden` – authenticated user whose role is not allowed for the endpoint/action.
- `404 Not Found` – resource (product/order/cart item) does not exist or is out of scope.
- `422 Unprocessable Entity` – validation error or business rule violation (empty cart, insufficient stock, invalid status).

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Endpoints to register, login, logout and inspect the authenticated user.

request.description:
Registers a new user. Role must be either `customer` or `salesman`. Returns a bearer token.

Body fields:
- `name` (string, required)
- `email` (string, required, unique, email)
- `password` (string, required, min 4)
- `password_confirmation` (string, required, must match password)
- `role` (string, required, `customer` or `salesman`)

response.name: 422 Validation Error

request.description: Signs a user in and returns a new bearer token. The response token is automatically stored in the `{{token}}` collection variable.

response.name: 422 Validation Error

request.description: Admin-only endpoint. Confirms a user's email address. Requires the `admin` role (set `{{token}}` to `{{admin_token}}`).

response.name: 403 Forbidden (non-admin)

item.name: Products
item.description: Product management. List/view are available to `customer`, `salesman` and `admin`. Create/update/delete require `salesman` or `admin`.

request.description:
Lists all products. `admin` sees every product, `salesman` sees only their own products, `customer` sees all products.

Response is wrapped in a `data` key (Laravel API Resource).

item.name: Cart
item.description: Shopping cart management for `customer` and `admin` roles.

request.description: Returns the current user's cart with item lines and totals. Response is wrapped in a `data` key (Laravel API Resource).

Adds a product to the cart. If the product already exists in the cart, the quantity is incremented.

Body fields:
- `product_id` (integer, required, must exist)
- `quantity` (integer, required, min 1)

response.name: 422 Validation Error

request.description: Sets the quantity of an existing cart item. The path `productId` must match the `product_id` sent in the body.
Removes a product from the cart by product ID.
